entries.zh: 篦仔（细齿梳；汉字栏或作「敏仔」）
entries.en: fine-tooth comb; small brush
entries.notes: 汉字栏带[疑]（敏/箆之辨），依 escobilla（小刷/篦梳）语境取篦义，属推断。

entries.en: small broom; little brush
broom
small ball/wad for cleaning the ears; earwax ball
entries.notes: M 作 ſiau、R 作 jan，两音写互不一致且均不合「毬」之常读，仅凭词头（耳用小帚）与汉字推释，存疑。

entries.zh: 清耳用的小绒球（毬穩；「穩」字待考）
entries.en: small wad/ball for the ears (compound uncertain)
entries.notes: R 栏两处污損（T99），M fit 与汉字「穩」不合、穩或误辨，姑据词头释掏耳小球，存疑。

entries.en: to choose; to select
to pick out; to select
to choose; to select
entries.notes: 音写栏带[疑]（Teç/Zeç），汉字「擇」与词头明确。

entries.en: to choose; to pick out
to pick and choose; to select
to choose; to select

entries.zh: 占卜（占卦择定吉凶）；占取（职缺）
entries.en: to divine (to choose by divination); to take/occupy (an office)
entries.notes: 词头缩写 p.a off.o（para officio）展开依赖推断，「占」与 escoger 之关联取占卜择定义，属推断。

entries.zh: 起贡（擢为贡生；亦指起解进献贡物）
entries.en: to be raised up as tribute (student); to send up tribute goods
entries.notes: 「起贡」非习见复合词，据同组第 16 条「选贡」及词头（为职选人）语境推断为贡选义。

entries.zh: 选贡（选送贡生；明清贡生选贡之制）
entries.en: to select as tribute student (xuangong); tribute-student selection
entries.notes: 词头缩写展开依赖推断；「选贡」为明清贡生选送制度语，与 escoger para officio 相合。

entries.zh: 中选；中意（君王选中所欲）
entries.en: to hit the mark; to be chosen as the king pleases
entries.notes: 词头 cumpl.to（cumplimiento）缩写展开依赖推断，音写变体含涂改字；「中」取中选/中意义系据本页第 20 条「中選」。

entries.zh: 目录；篇目（汇编所选佳句之总目）
entries.en: catalog; table of contents (of a compilation of selected sayings)
to pick whatever one likes; to choose as one pleases
entries.notes: 第二字带[疑]（着/看），据词头 escoger lo que quisiere 定读作「拣着中意」。

entries.en: to be selected; to be chosen at one's pleasure

entries.zh: 择风水（相地看风水；稿中原注：此乃迷信）
entries.en: to select by geomancy (fengshui); manuscript note: 'it is superstition'
